vi: Thiết kế job lifecycle với state machine (PENDING → PROCESSING → COMPLETED/FAILED) để tách ingestion khỏi transcoding mà không block HTTP handler.
Triển khai fire-and-forget pattern bằng background execution để xử lý công việc nặng (FFmpeg) sau khi trả HTTP 202 ngay.
Áp dụng idempotency guard (query job cùng inputPath trước INSERT) để ngăn spawn FFmpeg lặp lại khi client retry.
Sử dụng presigned URL sinh theo yêu cầu để cấp quyền download tạm thời thay vì lưu URL tĩnh vào database.
Xử lý recovery job kẹt ở PROCESSING sau crash service bằng startup routine query timeout để tái-enqueue hoặc đánh dấu FAILED.
en: Design a job lifecycle with state machine (PENDING → PROCESSING → COMPLETED/FAILED) to decouple ingestion from transcoding without blocking the HTTP handler.
Implement the fire-and-forget pattern using background execution to process heavy work (FFmpeg) after returning HTTP 202 immediately.
Apply an idempotency guard (query for existing job with same inputPath before INSERT) to prevent duplicate FFmpeg spawns on client retry.
Use presigned URLs generated on-demand to grant temporary download permissions rather than storing static URLs in the database.
Handle recovery of jobs stuck in PROCESSING after service crash using a startup routine that queries for timed-out entries and re-enqueues or marks them FAILED.
